md_flux_1_schnell.notes: Apache-2.0 weights, but the repo is gated on HuggingFace (anonymous download returns 401), so fetching it requires an HF token with the terms accepted.

md_flux_1_dev.notes: Gated repo under the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial License; requires accepting the license and an HF token.

md_flux_1_krea_dev.notes: Gated repo under the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial License.

md_flux_1_fill_dev.notes: Gated repo under the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial License.

md_flux_1_kontext_dev.notes: Gated repo under the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial License.

md_flux_2_dev.notes: Gated repo under the FLUX.2 [dev] Non-Commercial License.

md_flux_2_dev_nvfp4.notes: NVFP4 quantization of FLUX.2 [dev]; inherits its Non-Commercial License.

md_flux_2_dev_bnb_4bit.notes: Hosted under the diffusers org but a bitsandbytes 4-bit quantization of FLUX.2 [dev]; inherits its Non-Commercial License, so it is keyed to black_forest_labs.

md_flux_2_dev_turbo.notes: Hosted by fal but a distillation of FLUX.2 [dev]; inherits its Non-Commercial License, so it is keyed to black_forest_labs.

md_flux_2_klein_4b.notes: Apache-2.0 and ungated. Only the 4B klein tier is permissive; the 9B tier is non-commercial and gated.

md_flux_2_klein_4b_fp8.notes: Apache-2.0 and ungated. Only the 4B klein tier is permissive; the 9B tier is non-commercial and gated.

md_flux_2_klein_4b_nvfp4.notes: Apache-2.0 and ungated. Only the 4B klein tier is permissive; the 9B tier is non-commercial and gated.

md_flux_2_klein_9b.notes: Gated repo under the FLUX.2 Non-Commercial License (HuggingFace reports license_name=flux-non-commercial-license and gated). The klein line splits by size tier: the 4B releases are Apache-2.0 and ungated, the 9B releases are neither.

md_flux_2_klein_9b_fp8.notes: Gated repo under the FLUX.2 Non-Commercial License (HuggingFace reports license_name=flux-non-commercial-license and gated). The klein line splits by size tier: the 4B releases are Apache-2.0 and ungated, the 9B releases are neither.

md_flux_2_klein_9b_nvfp4.notes: Gated repo under the FLUX.2 Non-Commercial License (HuggingFace reports license_name=flux-non-commercial-license and gated). The klein line splits by size tier: the 4B releases are Apache-2.0 and ungated, the 9B releases are neither.

md_flux_2_klein_base_4b.notes: Apache-2.0 and ungated. Only the 4B klein tier is permissive; the 9B tier is non-commercial and gated.

md_flux_2_klein_base_9b.notes: Gated repo under the FLUX.2 Non-Commercial License (HuggingFace reports license_name=flux-non-commercial-license and gated). The klein line splits by size tier: the 4B releases are Apache-2.0 and ungated, the 9B releases are neither.

md_flux_1_dev_controlnet_union_instantx.notes: Hosted by InstantX but released under the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial License it derives from, so it is keyed to black_forest_labs and a BFL-scoped rule covers it.

md_flux_1_dev_controlnet_union_pro.notes: Hosted by Shakker Labs but released under the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial License it derives from.

md_flux_1_dev_controlnet_union_pro_2.notes: Hosted by Shakker Labs but released under the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial License it derives from.

md_sdxl_inpainting_0_1.notes: Hosted under the diffusers org but an SDXL 1.0 derivative under CreativeML Open RAIL++-M, so it is keyed to stability.

md_sd3_medium.notes: Gated repo under the Stability Community License; requires accepting the license and an HF token.

md_sd3_5_medium.notes: Gated repo under the Stability Community License.

md_sd3_5_large.notes: Gated repo under the Stability Community License.

md_sd3_5_large_turbo.notes: Gated repo under the Stability Community License.

md_sd3_5m_controlnet_depth.notes: Published by Tensor.Art but released under the Stability AI Community License as a stable-diffusion-3.5-medium derivative, so it is keyed to stability and a Stability-scoped rule covers it.

md_sd3_5m_controlnet_canny.notes: Published by Tensor.Art but released under the Stability AI Community License as a stable-diffusion-3.5-medium derivative, so it is keyed to stability and a Stability-scoped rule covers it.

dashscope.notes: Keyed to match the standard library's provider id for Alibaba so one admin rule covers both the hosted API and these local weights. Covers the Qwen, Wan, and Z-Image lines.

md_qwen_image_controlnet_union.notes: Hosted by InstantX; Apache-2.0 like the Qwen-Image base it derives from, and keyed to the same authority so a Qwen-scoped rule covers it.

md_qwen_image_controlnet_inpainting.notes: Hosted by InstantX; Apache-2.0 like the Qwen-Image base it derives from.

md_z_image_turbo.notes: Apache-2.0. Published by Alibaba's Tongyi-MAI org.

md_z_image_turbo_fun_controlnet_union.notes: Published by Alibaba's PAI org; same authority as the Z-Image base it derives from.

md_z_image_turbo_fun_controlnet_union_2_.notes: Published by Alibaba's PAI org; same authority as the Z-Image base it derives from.

tencent.notes: HunyuanVideo weights are released under the Tencent Hunyuan Community License, which restricts some territories and use cases.

md_hunyuan_video_1_5_480p_t2v.notes: Community Diffusers conversion; keyed to tencent because it inherits the Hunyuan Community License.

md_hunyuan_video_1_5_480p_t2v_distilled.notes: Community Diffusers conversion; inherits the Hunyuan Community License.

md_hunyuan_video_1_5_720p_t2v.notes: Community Diffusers conversion; inherits the Hunyuan Community License.

md_hunyuan_video_1_5_480p_i2v.notes: Community Diffusers conversion; inherits the Hunyuan Community License.

md_hunyuan_video_1_5_480p_i2v_distilled.notes: Community Diffusers conversion; inherits the Hunyuan Community License.

md_hunyuan_video_1_5_480p_i2v_step_disti.notes: Community Diffusers conversion; inherits the Hunyuan Community License.

md_hunyuan_video_1_5_720p_i2v.notes: Community Diffusers conversion; inherits the Hunyuan Community License.

md_hunyuan_video_1_5_720p_i2v_distilled.notes: Community Diffusers conversion; inherits the Hunyuan Community License.

xinsir.notes: Independently licensed (Apache-2.0) SDXL ControlNets. Keyed to their own authority rather than stability because their license does not derive from SDXL's.

instantx.notes: SD3 ControlNets published by InstantX. Only SD3-Controlnet-Depth declares Apache-2.0; the others declare no license and their terms are unverified. The InstantX FLUX and Qwen ControlNets are keyed to their base authority instead, because those inherit the base terms.

md_sd3_controlnet_canny.notes: This repo declares no license on HuggingFace, so its terms are unverified. Kept under its publisher rather than assumed permissive; if it is later confirmed to follow Stable Diffusion 3's terms it should be re-keyed to stability.

md_sd3_controlnet_pose.notes: This repo declares no license on HuggingFace, so its terms are unverified. Kept under its publisher rather than assumed permissive; if it is later confirmed to follow Stable Diffusion 3's terms it should be re-keyed to stability.

md_sd3_controlnet_tile.notes: This repo declares no license on HuggingFace, so its terms are unverified. Kept under its publisher rather than assumed permissive; if it is later confirmed to follow Stable Diffusion 3's terms it should be re-keyed to stability.

md_sd3_controlnet_inpainting.notes: This repo declares no license on HuggingFace, so its terms are unverified. Kept under its publisher rather than assumed permissive; if it is later confirmed to follow Stable Diffusion 3's terms it should be re-keyed to stability.

alimama_creative.notes: Declares license 'other' with no named license; terms unverified.

ltx.notes: Keyed to match the standard library's provider id for Lightricks so one admin rule covers both the hosted LTX API and these local weights. LTX-Video weights are released under the LTX-Video Open Weights License, which carries use restrictions beyond a permissive OSS license.

md_ltx_2_3_diffusers.notes: Community Diffusers conversion of Lightricks' LTX 2.3 weights; keyed to ltx because it inherits the LTX-Video Open Weights License.

md_ltx_2_3_distilled_diffusers.notes: Community Diffusers conversion of Lightricks' LTX 2.3 distilled weights; inherits the LTX-Video Open Weights License.

md_ltx_2_3_spatial_upsampler_diffusers.notes: Community Diffusers conversion of Lightricks' LTX 2.3 spatial upsampler; inherits the LTX-Video Open Weights License.

md_ltx_2_5_diffusers.notes: Gated repo on Hugging Face; requires accepting Lightricks' license and an authenticated HF token to download. Inherits the LTX-Video Open Weights License.

md_minimax_h3.notes: Gated repo under the MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement; requires accepting the license and an HF token.

metadata.description: Build and cache latent-compatible 🧨 Diffusers Pipelines. Any LoRAs wired into this node are fused permanently into the cached weights — changing them rebuilds the pipeline. For dynamic adapters that swap per generation, use the LoRA Pipeline node instead.
Generate latents via 🧨 Diffusers Pipelines.
Create an initial noise latent tensor for a selected 🧨 Diffusers pipeline.
Create a zero-filled (empty) latent tensor for a selected 🧨 Diffusers pipeline.
Add two latent artifacts elementwise.
Subtract the right latent from the left latent elementwise.
Multiply two latent artifacts elementwise.
Save a latent artifact to a torch .pt file.
Encode images or video into VAE latent space via 🧨 Diffusers Pipelines.
Encode a source image and mask into an inpaint artifact (mask + masked-image latent) for use with inpainting pipelines.
Decode VAE latent images or video via 🧨 Diffusers Pipelines.
Decode HDR VAE latent, apply tone mapping, and optionally save a raw EXR sequence.
Composite two latent tensors together by pasting masked latent into destination latent.
ControlNet node for configuring different ControlNet models.
Add ControlNet model to the pipeline.

Layers non-fused LoRA adapters on top of an existing pipeline. The base pipeline stays untouched, so the same model can power multiple branches (one with adapters, one without). Adapters are loaded and activated per generation, then released — ideal for in-context (IC) LoRAs, distillation/acceleration LoRAs, slider LoRAs, or any workflow that swaps adapters between runs.
Conditioning node for media generation pipelines. Supports image or video conditioning inputs with configurable strength.
Spatially upsample a latent tensor using a latent upsampler model.
Forcefully evicts all cached diffusion pipelines from GPU/CPU memory. Use this node when diagnosing out-of-memory errors or when you need a clean slate before loading a different model.

Load a LoRA file from a local path and expose it as a `loras` output. Wire to the Modular Diffusion Pipeline Builder to fuse the LoRA into the cached weights, or to a LoRA Pipeline node to activate it dynamically per generation.

Load a single pipeline component (transformer / unet / vae / tokenizer / text_encoder) from a single-file checkpoint, a local diffusers-format folder, or a local HuggingFace repo cache. Wire into a Pipeline Builder override port to inject the component at build time into the pipeline.

Configure a scheduler by choosing a scheduler class and a scheduler_config.json source (local file/folder or a local HuggingFace repo cache). Wire into a Pipeline Builder scheduler override port to replace the pipeline's scheduler at build time.
